issues.summary: Preceding rows' isLast ignores the Safenet row
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: TxSigners/index.tsx:281 and :292 now compute isLast with `!showsSafenetRow && !showExecutionRow`, and the Safenet row itself gets `isLast={!showExecutionRow}`. So the preceding rows already account for the Safenet step.

issues.summary: Parent can't know whether SafenetAuditRow will render
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: TxSigners/index.tsx:170-174 subscribes to the same useSafenetCheck cache entry and mirrors the row's render gate in `showsSafenetRow`. That is exactly how the parent learns whether the row will render.

issues.summary: showsSafenetRow can be true before the lazy chunk loads, leaving a dangling connector
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: TxSigners/index.tsx:173 never checks `safenet.$isReady`. If check data is already cached (keepUnusedDataFor 300) before the chunk resolves, the last signed row loses isLast while the stub renders null. The effect is a brief visual glitch.

issues.summary: Render gate duplicated between TxSigners and SafenetAuditRow
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: TxSigners/index.tsx:173-174 re-implements the check at SafenetAuditRow.tsx:68, and the comment admits the two must stay in sync. Drift would silently break the connector math.

issues.summary: useLoadFeature triggers the import even when disabled; enabled check should move into the row
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: useLoadFeature.ts:194 returns early unless `isEnabled === true`, so no import happens while the flag is off. isSafenetEnabled in TxSigners gates the hash subscription for the isLast math, not the row's render (the registry stub already covers that).

issues.summary: `=== true` collapses loading undefined to false
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: index.ts:10 turns undefined into false, so `$isDisabled` briefly reads true while the chain config resolves. Nothing reads `$isDisabled` here, and the row loads once the flag resolves, so the impact is negligible.

issues.summary: Hand-written feature handle instead of createFeatureHandle
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: createFeatureHandle('safenet-checks') would auto-derive FEATURES.SAFENET_CHECKS and build the same load path (createFeatureHandle.ts). index.ts:12-16 duplicates that, with only the `=== true` coercion as a difference.

issues.summary: Redundant NEXT_PUBLIC_SAFENET_CHECKS_FORCE env override
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: NEXT_PUBLIC_SAFENET_CHECKS_FORCE does not appear anywhere in apps/ or packages/ at HEAD. index.ts:10 uses only useHasFeature, and .env.example has no such variable.

issues.summary: NEXT_PUBLIC_SAFENET_EXPLORER_URL not documented in .env.example
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: constants.ts:53 reads NEXT_PUBLIC_/EXPO_PUBLIC_SAFENET_EXPLORER_URL, but grep finds no EXPLORER entry in apps/web/.env.example, even though that file's new Safenet section documents the other SAFENET_* variables.

issues.summary: .env.example lacks trailing newline
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: od shows the file ends with `NEXT_PUBLIC_SAFENET_ORACLE_ADDRESSES=` and no final newline. This is cosmetic.

issues.summary: No Storybook story for SafenetAuditRow
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: apps/web/AGENTS.md:10 and :148 require a story for a new component with logic, and none was added for the five status states or dark mode.

issues.summary: 'One RPC per settled check' comment inaccurate while verification is PENDING
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: safenetReader.ts:430 can return PENDING (AWAITING_VERIFICATION). computePollingInterval.ts:27-44 keeps polling for that status, and safenetCheckApi.ts:56-59 calls blockTimeMs on every such poll. That means one extra header read per poll in that rare state.

issues.summary: No-attestation test doesn't assert blockTimeMs not called
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: safenetCheckApi.test.ts:104-117 asserts verifyAttestation is not called but never checks blockTimeMs, so the gate is only partly pinned.

issues.summary: Oracle-preferred attestation selection duplicated in component and API
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: SafenetAuditRow.tsx:78-80 repeats the find-oracle-then-plain logic from safenetCheckApi.ts:50-52. If the API's choice changed, the link could point at an event other than the one verified.

issues.summary: ORACLE_ATTESTED-preferred link path untested
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The component tests build only plainAttestedEvent snapshots, so the oracle-preferred branch at SafenetAuditRow.tsx:79 has no coverage. The API-side oracle preference is tested (safenetCheckApi.test.ts:223), but the link selection is not.

issues.summary: TIMED_OUT label and dark-mode icon colors untested
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: grep finds no TIMED_OUT or dark-mode case in SafenetAuditRow.test.tsx, so the DARK_STEP_COLOR branch (SafenetAuditRow.tsx:94) and the 'Safenet check failed' label are not covered.

issues.summary: Flag-off TxSigners test weakly proves the gate
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The claim is partly true. TxSigners always calls useSafenetCheck, so the loop at index.test.tsx:719 isn't vacuous and does catch a broken hash gate. But the negative text assertion depends on a return value leaking from the prior test (clearAllMocks keeps implementations), so it wouldn't catch a broken registry stub in isolation.

issues.summary: MALICIOUS and TIMED_OUT rows never get a timestamp
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: MALICIOUS comes from ORACLE_RESULT and TIMED_OUT from the deadline (deriveCheckState:66,88), but attestedAtMs is computed only when an attested event exists (safenetCheckApi.ts:56). So those rows show no date, and the comment at SafenetAuditRow.tsx:104 doesn't mention it.

issues.summary: Light mode doesn't color error/warning icons
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: This is intended. SafenetAuditRow.tsx:31 says 'Dark mode only', and the PR description says status colors apply in dark mode only, with the label carrying severity in light mode.

issues.summary: Long explanatory comments conflict with the comments-as-debt guidance
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: Several block comments (TxSigners/index.tsx:166-168, :296-298; SafenetAuditRow.tsx:97) are verbose, and some restate the code. This is style, with no functional cost.

issues.summary: Redundant optional chaining on snapshot after early return
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: SafenetAuditRow.tsx:68 returns when !snapshot, so `snapshot?.events` at :79-80 is redundant. Harmless.

issues.summary: useChain('') empty-string fallback
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: SafenetAuditRow.tsx:65 calls useChain with '' until a snapshot exists. It returns undefined, so this is readability only.

issues.summary: TxSigners imports useSafenetCheck from the utils package, bypassing the feature boundary
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: useSafenetCheck is a shared-package hook (packages/utils), not a web-feature internal. The web feature doesn't re-export it, and AGENTS.md allows importing hooks directly.

issues.summary: feature.tsx instead of feature.ts
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: Every other feature uses feature.ts, and this file contains no JSX, so .tsx is needless. The dynamic import still resolves, so it's only an inconsistency.

issues.summary: Component not in components/<Component>/index.tsx layout
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: Other features also use flat component files, e.g. feature-flag-overrides/components/FeatureFlagRow.tsx and proposers/components/DeleteProposerDialog.tsx. The convention isn't enforced.

issues.summary: Test in __tests__ directory rather than colocated
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: __tests__ directories are an established pattern in this repo (safe-shield/components/__tests__, and AGENTS.md:146 lists hooks/__tests__). It's a style preference.
